content_zh:
这个时候已经快到中午了。
把三女一狼的肚子撑的圆鼓鼓的，才轮到龙飞自己。
“喂！”
“做我们的保镖，送我们回火璃城，好不好？”小师妹很不客气的说道。
龙飞瞥了她一眼，道：“炼血宗的人都走了，你们还怕什么，自己走回去就行，还要我保护做什么。”
“骗子。”说完还小声嘀咕，“都是骗子。”
大师姐也走上来，道：“我们体内还残留炼血迷魂烟，虽然不会再昏迷，可是修为短时间内无法全部恢复，希望少侠能护送我们回火璃城。”
二师姐也跟着说道：“少侠，你就好人做到底吧。”
这个时候，就连小白狼也咬着龙飞的裤腿，两眼汪汪的看着他，要他帮助三女。
真是白养了半年多。
龙飞本想拒绝的。
可是，系统响起提示音。
“叮！”
“触发任务：护送朝天宗三姐妹回火璃城。”
“任务等级：B级”
“任务奖励：1万经验，1千点真气值，黄三品开荒刀一把。”
“触发护送任务了？”龙飞呼出一口气，无奈只能答应，道：“好吧。”
心中暗道：“反正我也好回火璃城。”
他的声音一落，三女立刻高兴起来，抱起小白狼又是一阵戏耍，然后……继续无视龙飞的存在。
小白狼也是一样，完全沉醉在她们的身体之中。

小师妹嘻嘻笑道：“我真舍不得小白，不然才不要他护送呢。”
龙飞无语了。
既然接受任务了，他就会去完成。
他也想早点回火璃城，突然发现，原来这个世界上对他好的人只有乔乔。
半个月的赶路，终于走出火璃山脉。
半个月的接触，龙飞存在感非常的小，他也习惯了。
三女是漂亮，可是她们都是朝天宗的弟子。
朝天宗的实力他还是知道的，比火璃王朝都要强。简单点来说，朝天宗就是贵族学校，巅峰天才的聚集地，高手云集，就算他是四大天柱之一的龙家子弟想进去也得通过重重考核，层层筛选，符合资格才能进去。
在火璃城有朝天宗的分部。
三女这次来是为了明年开春时招收弟子的事情。
半日后。
火璃城西门口。
“叮！”
“恭喜玩家‘龙飞’完成护送任务，获得经验1万点，真气1千点，黄三品开荒刀一把。”
“好了。”
“就此别过，拜拜，慢走，不送。”
龙飞归心似箭，任务完成也就不想在多停留半秒。
三女都是一愣。
相互看了一眼，内心都在怀疑自己的魅力不够？为什么这个男人巴不得早点离开她们？
女人是最奇怪的动物，对她好时不屑一顾，对她不好时觉得自己魅力不足。

大师姐从怀里拿出一枚令牌，说道：“这是朝天宗的令牌，你有任何事情都可以来火璃城朝天宗分部来找我，你也可以用这令牌无需海选直接参加朝天宗的选拔考核。”
朝天宗的令牌！
这可是非常珍贵的东西，就连皇宫贵族子弟都得不到的好东西。
有东西拿，龙飞自然不会拒绝。
接过之后，说了句，“谢谢。”
“小白，我们走！”
说完，头也不会就离开了。
三女当场就呆住了。
“什么人嘛，难道他不知道朝天宗令牌意味着什么吗？哼，肯定是个土豹子。”小师妹气鼓鼓的说道。
大师姐淡淡一笑，道：“他可能有急事要离开，我们也走吧。”
二师姐喃喃自语道：“他的名字叫龙飞，这个名字我总觉得在哪里听到过一样。”
“二师姐，他刚离开你就开始想他了，你思春咯。”小师妹打趣的说道。
二师姐顿时就发飙，“好你个小妮子，竟然拿师姐开玩笑，看我不好好教训教训你。”
“大师姐，救命呀。”
三女就这样打闹起来，对火璃山脉发生的事情也慢慢忘记，心中对炼血宗的惧意慢慢淡化掉。
她们并不知道，炼血宗的人在他们之前就来到火璃城。
他们不是对付朝天宗的，而是找诸葛坚强的。
芙蓉酒楼。
火璃城内最为出名的酒楼之一。
龙飞并没有第一时间去贫民窟找乔乔，而是先来到这里，“乔乔最喜欢吃这家酒楼的芙蓉包子。”

他也饿了，吃了半年的烤肉，也想换换口味。
要了个包间，要了一桌子的菜。
龙飞刚要开始吃，包间的门就被推开，一名身穿华丽服侍纨绔少年走了进来，身后跟着两名保镖。

content_en:
It was almost noon by this time.
After the belly of the three women and one wolf was bulging, it was Long Fei's turn.
"Hey!"
"Can you be our bodyguard and take us back to Huolicheng?" the junior sister said very rudely.
Long Fei glanced at her and said: "The people from the Blood Refining Sect have left. What are you afraid of? Just walk back by yourself. Why do you need my protection?"
"Liars." After saying this, he muttered in a low voice, "They are all liars."
The senior sister also came up and said: "The blood refining soul smoke still remains in our bodies. Although we will not be unconscious again, our cultivation levels cannot be fully recovered in a short time. I hope the young hero can escort us back to Huo Li City."
The second senior sister also said: "Young hero, you should be a good person and do it to the end."
At this time, even the little white wolf was biting Long Fei's trouser leg, looking at him with watery eyes, asking him to help the three girls.
It's been more than half a year in vain.
Long Fei wanted to refuse.
However, the system sounded a beep.
"Ding!"
"Trigger mission: Escort the three sisters of Chaotian Sect back to Huolicheng."
"Mission level: B level"
"Task reward: 10,000 experience points, 1,000 Qi points, and a yellow third-grade land reclamation knife."
"Triggered the escort mission?" Long Fei exhaled and had no choice but to agree, "Okay."
He thought to himself: "I can go back to Huoli City anyway."
As soon as his voice fell, the three women immediately became happy, picked up the little white wolf and played with it for a while, and then... continued to ignore Long Fei's existence.
Little White Wolf was the same, completely intoxicated in their bodies.
The junior sister giggled and said, "I really can't bear to leave Xiaobai, otherwise I wouldn't want him to escort me."
Long Fei was speechless.
Since he accepted the task, he will complete it.
He also wanted to return to Huolicheng as soon as possible, but suddenly discovered that the only person in the world who was good to him was Qiao Qiao.
After half a month of traveling, we finally walked out of the Huoli Mountains.
After half a month of contact, Long Fei's presence was very small, and he was used to it.
The three girls are beautiful, but they are all disciples of the Chaotian Sect.
He still knew the strength of Chaotian Sect, it was stronger than Huoli Dynasty. To put it simply, Chaotian Sect is an aristocratic school, a gathering place for peak geniuses and masters. Even if he is one of the four pillars of the Long family and wants to enter, he has to pass numerous assessments and layers of screenings before he can enter if he meets the qualifications.
There is a branch of Chaotian Sect in Huoli City.
The three girls came here this time to recruit disciples in the spring of next year.
Half a day later.
The west entrance of Huoli City.
"Ding!"
"Congratulations to the player 'Long Fei' for completing the escort mission. He has gained 10,000 experience points, 1,000 Qi points, and a third-grade yellow land reclamation knife."
"Okay."
"Goodbye, goodbye, walk slowly, no farewell."
Long Fei's heart was as fast as an arrow, and he didn't want to stay for half a second after his mission was completed.
The three women were all stunned.
They glanced at each other, wondering in their hearts that they were not charming enough? Why is this man eager to leave them early?
Women are the strangest animals. They are dismissive when they are good to her, and they feel that they are not attractive enough when they are not good to her.
The senior sister took out a token from her arms and said: "This is the token of the Chaotian Sect. If you have anything to do, you can come to me at the Chaotian Sect branch in Huoli City. You can also use this token to directly participate in the Chaotian Sect's selection assessment without the audition."
The token of Chaotian Sect!
This is a very precious thing, a good thing that even the noble children of the royal palace cannot get.
If there is something to take, Long Fei will naturally not refuse it.
After taking it, he said, "Thank you."
"Xiaobai, let's go!"
After saying that, he left without even turning his head.
The three women were stunned on the spot.
"Who is he? Doesn't he know what the Chaotian Sect's token means? Huh, he must be a local leopard." The junior sister said angrily.
The senior sister smiled faintly and said: "He may have something urgent to leave, so let's go too."
The second senior sister murmured to herself: "HisThe name is Long Fei. I always feel like I have heard the same name somewhere. "
"Second senior sister, you started to miss him right after he left. You are thinking about spring. "The junior sister said jokingly.
The second senior sister immediately became furious, "You little girl, you actually made fun of your senior sister, don't you think I'll teach you a lesson?" "
"Sister, help me. "
The three girls started playing around like this, gradually forgetting what happened in the Fire Glass Mountain Range, and the fear of the Blood Refining Sect in their hearts gradually faded away.
They didn't know that people from the Blood Refining Sect had arrived in Huoli City before them.
They are not dealing with Chaotian Sect, but Zhuge Jianqiang.
Furong Restaurant.
One of the most famous restaurants in Huoli City.
Long Fei did not go to the slums to find Qiao Qiao immediately, but came here first, "Qiao Qiao likes to eat the hibiscus buns from this restaurant the most. "
He was also hungry. He had eaten barbecue for half a year and wanted to change his taste.
I asked for a private room and a table of dishes.
Just as Long Fei was about to start eating, the door to the private room was pushed open, and a handsome young man in gorgeous clothes walked in, followed by two bodyguards.
